full_title: Tzu Chi Hero Kai - Guardian of Pythonia

demographics.proportions: 4.2 to 4.5 heads tall, heroic chibi / young adventurer anime proportions
demographics.build: Agile, athletic boy adventurer, sturdy stance, expressive posture

facial_features.face_shape: Round youthful face with gentle chin and soft jawline
facial_features.skin_tone: Warm fair skin with soft peachy-apricot blush on cheeks and bridge of nose

hair.style: Tousled anime-spiky hair, layered bangs parting softly over forehead, side locks framing ears, soft volume

eyes.shape: Large expressive rounded anime eyes, dark upper lash line, subtle lower lash accent
eyes.highlights: Prominent white circular catchlight in upper pupil, soft crescent reflection on lower iris

facial_features.eyebrows: Thin expressive light brown eyebrows, arched for curiosity, angled for determination
facial_features.nose_and_mouth: Small delicate button nose, expressive gentle smile or focused determined mouth

standard_adventure.name: Standard Adventure Gear (Outfit A)
standard_adventure.description: Kai's signature iconic traveling attire for exploring Pythonia and helping communities

cloak.material: Textured woolen traveling cloak with soft painterly drape, reaching mid-calf
cloak.hood: Voluminous hood resting comfortably behind neck and shoulders when lowered
cloak.fastener: Golden crescent moon brooch (Hex: #D4AF37) with delicate etched botanical scrollwork at the collarbone

tunic.style: Double-breasted crossover front, Mandarin standing collar
tunic.buttons: Vertical double row of small round dark espresso-brown horn/wooden buttons
tunic.hem: Mid-thigh length with front/side split for mobility

pants.color: Matching off-white / warm cream linen breeches (Hex: #EDE8DE)
pants.fit: Loose comfortable adventure fit, cleanly tucked into riding boots

belt_and_buckle.belt: Sturdy chestnut brown leather belt (Hex: #5C361E) with cross-body baldric strap across chest
belt_and_buckle.signature_buckle: The Tzu Chi Foundation Medallion: Green jade/enamel shield crest (Hex: #1F6A38) featuring the white three-sailed Dharma ship sailing over ocean waves, flanked by stylized golden/bronze lotus petals and wings (Hex: #C29B38)

pouches.right_hip: Sturdy rectangular saddle-leather utility satchel with rounded flap and brass peg fastener
pouches.left_hip: Custom three-slot leather potion holster holding 3 glass phials with cork stoppers

bracers.material: Warm brown leather vambraces from wrist to mid-forearm
bracers.detail: Inner forearm criss-cross leather cord lacing through eyelets

boots.style: Wide folded-over cuffs at mid-calf, rounded toes, sturdy low-heel travel soles

weapon.type: Single-handed fantasy arming sword worn across back
weapon.pommel: Circular steel pommel with inset crescent moon / concentric ring emblem
weapon.grip: Warm brown spiral cord-wrapped leather grip
weapon.crossguard: Straight steel crossguard with chamfered quillons
weapon.scabbard: Hand-carved oak and tooled leather scabbard featuring deeply embossed laurel leaf and vine motif, fitted with polished steel chape tip

stealth_rogue.name: Stealth & Rogue Attire (Outfit B)
stealth_rogue.description: Tactical covert infiltration gear for silent nighttime missions
stealth_rogue.main_garment: Dark charcoal / slate grey fitted tunic and matching trousers (Hex: #2C3038)
stealth_rogue.neck: Forest green infinity cowl / neck wrap
stealth_rogue.armor_pieces: Riveted brown leather pauldrons on shoulders, dark leather vambraces
stealth_rogue.belt: Dark leather utility belt with Tzu Chi medallion buckle and dual modular pouches
stealth_rogue.boots: Muffled dark brown leather stealth boots
stealth_rogue.sword: Matte darkened back scabbard to prevent light reflection

reinforced_combat.name: Reinforced Combat Armor (Outfit C)
reinforced_combat.description: Heavy defensive plate armor for confronting formidable monsters and protecting the innocent
reinforced_combat.cuirass: Segmented polished silver-steel chestplate with an embossed gilded golden crescent moon on upper chest
reinforced_combat.shoulders: Layered steel spaulders / shoulder plates with gilded gold borders
reinforced_combat.arms_and_legs: Steel gauntlets, faulds over cream tunic, segmented steel greaves over boots
reinforced_combat.cloak: Short deep green battle mantle pinned at neck
reinforced_combat.belt: Heavy steel-trimmed belt holding the glowing Tzu Chi green lotus crest front and center

arctic_survival.name: Arctic Survival Gear (Outfit D)
arctic_survival.description: Heavy insulated cold-weather attire for blizzards and glacial expeditions
arctic_survival.parka: Heavy slate-grey wool/canvas winter parka with thick plush cream shearling fur trim on hood, collar, cuffs, and hem
arctic_survival.mittens: Heavy insulated brown leather mittens with fur cuffs
arctic_survival.boots: Fur-lined winter mukluk boots with snow-traction soles
arctic_survival.accessories: Golden crescent brooch over fur collar, exterior thermal holster for potion phials, Tzu Chi belt

art_style_dna.primary_style: High-end anime/manga storybook illustration, Studio Ghibli and Akira Toriyama / Dragon Quest inspired
art_style_dna.line_art: Refined warm sepia and dark charcoal ink linework with delicate, hand-drawn lineweight variation
art_style_dna.shading_technique: Soft painterly gouache and watercolor shading with gentle paper grain texture
art_style_dna.color_palette: Harmonious earthy natural tones: moss greens (#345830), warm unbleached creams (#F4EFE6), rich saddle browns (#5C361E), accented by jewel emeralds, rubies, sapphires, and warm gold (#D4AF37)
art_style_dna.lighting: Warm golden-hour sunlight, dappled forest canopy light, soft ambient storybook glow, luminous potion highlights
art_style_dna.atmosphere: Whimsical, courageous, heartwarming, adventurous, compassionate, storybook fantasy

do: Always include the golden crescent moon clasp/brooch at the neck of the green cloak
Always include the green Tzu Chi lotus & sailing ship medallion buckle on the belt
Always render Kai's hair as sandy golden-blonde anime spikes with soft bangs
Always feature the 3 colorful glass potion phials (green, red, blue) on his left hip
Always keep his proportions consistent (around 4.2 to 4.5 heads tall, youthful heroic boy)
Maintain the warm, soft storybook watercolor/gouache illustration aesthetic with clean line art
Include the carved leafy vine pattern on his sword scabbard when visible on his back
dont: Do NOT turn Kai into an adult, hyper-realistic, or 3D CGI Pixar render
Do NOT remove the green cloak or replace the crescent moon brooch with generic fasteners
Do NOT forget the belt buckle or turn it into a generic blank metal buckle
Do NOT change hair color to black, brown, or platinum white
Do NOT omit the potion vials on his left hip in adventure gear
Do NOT make the tone grimdark, grotesque, or overly gritty — Kai represents hope, healing, and courage
